## Problem

Describe what happened and what you expected.

## Reproduction

Use a synthetic account and an original/public-domain book where possible. Include steps, app version/build, platform/OS, and book format.

## Validation

Explain whether this occurred on a simulator, native Mac, physical device, or server integration.

Do not attach tokens, passwords, private URLs, account/device IDs, personal library screenshots, or raw networking logs. Use private vulnerability reporting for security concerns.
